resources.string: Switch to Advanced before enabling roots (ADR-0005; under Standard, file tools only see the app-private scope).

Note: Android\'s All-files permission lets Helix access the public storage folders (Downloads, Documents, Pictures, etc.), but not other apps\' private directories or Android/data. Once you enable a root below, the agent can only reach the roots you explicitly select, and every file operation still goes through scope, Policy and per-call approval.
